articles.title: Fed's rate hike push may be a mistake. Here's why
articles.description: Experts argue that the Fed is looking at the wrong data as it pushes for more interest-rate hikes, with falling gasoline and energy prices suggesting inflation pressures are already easing.

articles.title: Ethereum block builders received the most in a $3.4 million vault hack, data shows
articles.description: An automated trading bot copied the attack on K3 Capital's sBOLD vault, taking more than half the funds and paying most of its proceeds to get its transactions processed first.

articles.title: Bitcoin miner that sold its last BTC warns it may run short of cash for $1.2 billion AI deal

articles.title: CZ says tokenized Anthropic is coming to BNB Chain on IPO day

articles.title: Payward, the owner of crypto exchange Kraken, is buying its CEO’s venture capital business, Tribe

articles.title: A $1.5 billion crypto startup is taking on Hyperliquid with a Wall Street playbook

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn’t double as the vault
articles.description: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it. Darren Jordan of Komainu argues institutions should keep trading and custody separate, as traditional markets have for decades, and sets out the questions to ask about where assets are held.

articles.title: German judge proposes dropping Movie2k case if operator hands over $2.56 billion in bitcoin
articles.description: Prosecutors estimate the defendant still holds 56,000 BTC, meaning the proposed deal would leave him with roughly $1 billion.

articles.title: Hong Kong wants banks to use AI to catch crypto crime before money disappears

articles.title: Bitcoin miner MARA raises $185 million in debt after selling $1 billion BTC to repay loans

articles.title: Bullish beats revenue estimates as institutional services offset sluggish spot crypto volumes
